name: Oil Change
description: Drain old oil, replace the oil filter, and refill with new oil.

name: Brake Pad Replacement
description: Replace the front or rear brake pads and inspect the rotors.

name: Tire Rotation
description: Rotate all four tires so they wear evenly.

name: Battery Replacement
description: Test the old battery and install a new one.

name: Engine Diagnostic
description: Scan the computer for error codes and find the problem.

name: A/C Recharge
description: Check the A/C system for leaks and recharge the refrigerant.
